## Featured Engineering Projects

### 1. NeuroSight (Healthcare AI / Neurological Screening)
- **Repository**: [https://github.com/MedBotix/NeuroSight](https://github.com/MedBotix/NeuroSight)
- **Core Focus**: Browser-based AI platform for early neurological screening using real-time eye-movement tracking.
- **Key Metrics**: 94% diagnostic accuracy, 47ms edge inference latency, 100% on-device patient privacy.
- **Tech Stack**: TensorFlow.js, React 19, FastAPI, Python.

### 2. RESP-AI (Acoustic AI / Pulmonary Health)
- **Repository**: [https://github.com/MedTechHealth/RESP-AI](https://github.com/MedTechHealth/RESP-AI)
- **Core Focus**: Real-time acoustic respiratory monitoring utilizing a two-stage convolutional neural network (CNN) cascade.
- **Key Metrics**: 97.3% classification accuracy, 94ms processing latency, 48 kHz continuous audio streaming.
- **Tech Stack**: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), Flutter, Python, WebSockets.

### 3. AirGuardian (Autonomous Robotics & SLAM)
- **Repository**: [https://github.com/Joel-Shibu](https://github.com/Joel-Shibu)
- **Core Focus**: Autonomous indoor drone system for industrial environmental intelligence and hazardous area inspection.
- **Key Metrics**: 500m² coverage capacity, 8-sensor IoT telemetry fusion, real-time autonomous SLAM navigation.
- **Tech Stack**: OpenCV visual processing, ESP32 (C++), Robot Operating System (ROS / ROS2), Arduino.
